text.3:121: And when thou settedst forth at daybreak from thy housefolk to assign to the believers their positions for the battle, Allah was Hearer, Knower.
text.9:81: Those who were left behind rejoiced at sitting still behind the messenger of Allah, and were averse to striving with their wealth and their lives in Allah's way. And they said: Go not forth in the heat! Say: The fire of hell is more intense of heat, if they but understood.
text.54:55: Firmly established in the favour of a Mighty King.
text.72:9: And we used to sit on places (high) therein to listen. But he who listeneth now findeth a flame in wait for him;
